role: Slim source/import support candidate index DATA; preserves unresolved source context and discovery seed groups; no semantic admission

method.selection: Complete support rows and exact seed groups from full census; retain every literal first-party edge crossing primary boundary or from support, every unresolved candidate, and supplemental Python file-loader AST call candidates. No source family purity exclusion.
method.python_context: For bare Python imports only, report an existing matching scripts module as a candidate plus preceding source lines mentioning sys.path or scripts path. Candidate/context is not proof that runtime sys.path resolution is fixed.
method.loader_context: AST call candidates spec_from_file_location, exec_module, module_from_spec and load_module retained; arguments kept as source text; execution targets remain unresolved unless separately reviewed.
method.limits: Full JS census is conservative text rather than semantic AST; emitted source strings/comments can overinclude. Dynamic aliases and generated code may need independent contextual review. Generated dist bytes remain absent from committed source and unadmitted.
